technical_normalizations.statement: One source context and direction produce one branch-independent physical idea ID; multiple source-permitted setup branches may descend from it without PnL-based selection.
Branch id is explicit in setup identity, but no priority/score/ranking selects a winner. Coexisting source-valid branches are preserved.
Directional setup objects inherit direction from their source-valid object/chain. No project macro/HTF direction override is applied.

For Range branches, setup direction is derived from the causally known deviation side: low-side deviation LONG, high-side deviation SHORT. The impulse direction that formed the Range does not override the later deviation direction.

For branches requiring a newly formed POI, only candidates known by decision_at and formed no earlier than the triggering BOS are considered. Zero candidates -> WAIT; more than one -> WAIT_NONUNIQUE; future candidates cannot alter an earlier setup.

When SOURCE requires a lower timeframe, Stage 7 requires the declared context TF to match the parent object and the refinement TF to be strictly lower. OB conservative additionally preserves the explicit 1-15m refinement scope. No universal H1->M5/H4->M15 mapping is SOURCE.

Causal objects carrying numeric-minute or m/h/d timeframe labels are normalized to minutes only to validate parent/refinement relation; unparseable labels remain UNKNOWN rather than receiving an invented mapping.
